subject: Role anchoring & equity + salary bands for Alex James (L5)
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Role anchoring & equity for Alex James (L5)

Hi team,

I want to align quickly on the offer approach for Alex James (SWE candidate, final on-site completed). Recruiter flagged expectation around base + equity at the higher end of the L5 band. Attached is the comp_band_matrix.xlsx and a first-pass offer letter. Key constraints: we need to keep within the current approved H1 L5 band for the org, but we're willing to use up-leveled equity to close.

Proposal (engineering/people input requested):
- Title: Senior Software Engineer II (L5)
- Base: $170,000 (within L5 midpoint; can go up to $180k with justification)
- Sign-on: $15,000 one-time (if required; prefer limited)
- Equity: 0.12% (~8,000 RSU equivalent) vesting 4y with 1y cliff — recommend slightly above midpoint for lateral hire
- Bonus: 10% annual target

Markus — do you want L5 or consider L6 (principal/IC stretch)? If we push to L6, budget and approvals change (would need compensation committee sign). Marissa — candidate expectations and timeline? Tessa — any HR flags for comp structure here?

Please review and reply with preferred anchor (L5 vs L6) and if you sign off on the equity increase. If all green, Marissa will extend draft offer to Alex.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role anchoring & equity for Alex James (L5)

Laura — quick take from hiring manager perspective.

I recommend L5 (Senior SWE II) rather than L6. Alex is strong on system design and mentoring, but not yet at the scale/strategy footprint we expect for L6. L6 would be a stretch title and could set a bad precedent for the squad.

On numbers: base at $175k is fine to be competitive; if candidate needs $180k to accept, I can justify. Equity at 0.12% is reasonable; I'd prefer 0.14% if we can flex within equity pool. Sign-on only if necessary — prefer equity.

I don't foresee performance or compliance issues. Please advise if escalation to comp committee is required for 0.14% equity.

— Markus
Eng Manager, Model Serving
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role anchoring & equity for Alex James (L5)

Thanks — quick update from candidate side and timeline.

Alex has indicated verbally that the target comp to move from his current role is $178k base OR $172k base + higher equity. He has back-to-back interest in a small equity bump over strict base increases. He is expecting a written offer by end of week to make a decision window work with his current employer. TalentBridge is fine with our approach.

Notes:
- Workday req: REQ-4589 already opened (linked)
- Candidate references check clean
- He prefers title Senior SWE II (L5) — doesn't push for L6

If we decide: 175k base + 0.14% equity + $10k sign-on (if needed) seems like an easy accept. If we go to 180k base I'd ask for no sign-on, but equity stays at ~0.12-0.14. Will prepare the offer_letter_draft.pdf for review. Can we get a final sign-off today so I can extend?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, talentbridge@talentbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-20T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role anchoring & equity for Alex James (L5)

Thanks all — final call: we should anchor at L5. Approved comp package below for Marissa to extend.

Final approved offer (sign-off from People & Eng):
- Title: Senior Software Engineer II (L5)
- Base: $178,000
- Equity: 0.14% (0.14 percent of company; standard 4y vest, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $10,000 one-time (to be used only if candidate pushes; otherwise skip)
- Bonus: 10% annual target

Rationale: keeps us competitive without creating title inflation. Equity bump closes gap and is within our pool allowance (Tessa, please confirm ledger). Markus — please confirm team budget is OK for $178k base vs 175k. If any issue arises, escalate to me immediately.

Marissa — please update offer_letter_draft.pdf with these numbers and add a short doc note on negotiation levers. Tessa — once you confirm ledger & Workday gross-up, proceed to prepare formal offer for Alex and loop in Security background check as usual.

Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex,

Great talking with you last week — excited to follow up. We'd like to extend an offer for the role of Senior Software Engineer II (L5) on the Model Serving team. Below are the headline terms; formal offer letter is attached.

Offer highlights:
- Base salary: $178,000 per year
- Target bonus: 10% of base annually (discretionary)
- Equity: 0.14% of Redwood (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $10,000 one-time (included in this offer)
- Start date: flexible — let us know your target start

Please see the attached offer_letter_draft.pdf for full terms, and reply by EOD Friday (8/27) if you can — we can discuss negotiation points if needed. If you have any questions about visa/benefits/tax with equity, loop us in and we'll connect you with People Ops.

Best,
